XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine fault light comes on with drop in performance
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | FUSE | P0010 | P0135 | P0141 | P0443 | LIGHTS UP | ON | YELLOW | YELLOW | MIL | POWER | RETURNS | LOSES | MISSING | SPEED | INJECTION |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Fuse position F11

  • Fault: Engine fault warning light illuminated with a drop in performance

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • P0010 (Camshaft position solenoid valve 1, bank 1 – Malfunction)
    • P0135 (Lambda sensor 1 heater circuit, bank 1 – Fault)
    • P0141 (Lambda sensor 2 heater circuit, bank 1 – Fault)
    • P0443 (Control system, fuel regeneration valve – Fault)
  • Cause: Fuse in position F11 blown

• Action: Replace fuse F11 (10 Amp capacity)

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, fuse F11 (injection component power supply (secondary) located in the engine compartment fuse box) was replaced.
